team_report.account: Many providers were overloaded, the team got off to a slow start, and running the datasets taught them a lot.

independently_documented: Early instance screenshot showed Building/Waiting; initial instance creations later failed.
A requested NeMo container image was unavailable; recovery used an available digest-pinned release.
283 source records minus 39 prefilter rejections minus 26 token-window drops produced 188 training and 30 development rows.
The 7B endpoint and required-tool checks passed, but a real coding task failed and applied no edit.
limits: The local logs do not independently diagnose provider overload as the cause of build or image-availability failures. Final quality and reduced human intervention remain unproven.
